entries.text: At times, I almost dream. I, too, have spent a life the sages' way... And tread once more familiar paths. Perchance, I've perished in an arrogant self-reliance an age ago, and in that act, a prayer for one more chance went up so earnest, so-- instinct with better light let in by death... That life was blotted out not so completely... But scattered wrecks, enough of it to remain dim memories... As now... When seems once more... The goal in sight again.

They'll be out of here in less than 24 hours if we cannot charge them. Agents on site will continue to search for evidence of illegal firearms. And, even more critical, find the informant sidney. Just as they had watched their brothers die days before on missionary ridge. We had received word... Of general cleburne's retreat from the union army. As a nurse, I had been ordered from Hamilton county to meet the troops, but... In actuality, I was searching for him, knowing that he would attempt to remain in Tennessee... Rather than retreat to dalton. I found him here... Amongst the others who had been lost... As general thomas pushed through the confederate line. The federal troops would appear from that direction. Rather than retreat any further, they fought them, hiding us in the bunker. Inside, I could smell the smoke, hear the rifles, feel the bodies as they dropped onto the ground above. entries.text: Sarah... If it were true... No life would be pointless.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ door opens ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Melissa... It's time to leave. Get out of here.
entries.speaker: Vernon Ephesian

entries.text: All right, let's go.
entries.speaker: Man

entries.text: I've reported to investigators on site about the possible existence of other bunkers.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: The field is not the property of the seven stars, so the b.a.t.f. Is continuing to search.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Mommy! They're home!
entries.speaker: Girl

entries.text: [ chattering ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Agent Mulder, the attorney general is furious as is. There's no way we're gonna get a go-ahead for a second move on the compound.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Ephesian preaches and his followers believe... That the FBI and the a.t.f. Are the devil's army, prophesied in revelations 12:17... To make war on "the seed which keep the commandments of god... And the testimony of jesus christ."
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Revelations tells of christian faith defeating that army.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You're saying he'll attack the a.t.f. Agents searching for the bunkers, believing, as prophesied, he'll win?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I would be saying that if I thought he believed in revelations in its entirety, but he hid the weapons.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Ephesian knew he couldn't defeat us.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: If he doesn't believe that he can defeat the devil's army, he may think that by denying himself and his followers to the devil-- by denying himself. You understand? He will achieve for them the reward of life forevermore, and our worst fears will be realized.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: All members to worship. The lord shall preserve you from all your evils. He shall preserve your soul. All members to worship. The lord shall preserve you from all your evil. He shall preserve your soul.
entries.speaker: Mighty Man

entries.text: Marvel not, my brethren, that the world hate you.
entries.speaker: Vernon Ephesian

entries.text: [ latches door, cocks rifle ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ Ephesian ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: We know we've passed from death unto life... Because we love the brethren.
entries.speaker: Vernon Ephesian

entries.text: No, I will not remove our people. We're close to finding the weapons.
entries.speaker: BATF Agent

entries.text: All I want is a cooling-off period.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Ephesian's gathered all temple members in the worship hall. A parabolic mike we have aimed at the compound just picked this up.
entries.speaker: Riggins

entries.text: [ Ephesian on tape ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Marvel not, brethren, that the world hate you.
entries.speaker: Vernon Ephesian (recording)

entries.text: [ door latched ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: We know we've passed from death unto life... Because we love the brethren. Hereby perceive we the love of god... Because he laid down his life for us.
entries.speaker: Vernon Ephesian (recording)

entries.text: [ typing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: The temple began running an interference frequency.
entries.speaker: Riggins

entries.text: First epistle of john, chapter three: "he laid down his life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren."
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Okay, Mulder.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: [ Ephesian ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life. My little children... Let us not love in word, neither in tongue, but in deed and truth. And hereby, we know that we are the truth. We shall endure.
entries.speaker: Vernon Ephesian

entries.text: Man down! Man down! Get him out of there!
entries.speaker: Man #1

entries.text: Cease fire! Hold your fire!
entries.speaker: Man #2

entries.text: [ agents chattering ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Is there contact with the temple?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: If you call that "contact."
entries.speaker: Agent

entries.text: He should be transported right away.
entries.speaker: Man

entries.text: And enter in through the Gates into the city! For without are dogs... And sorcerers... And whoremongers... And murderers, idolaters. Whomsoever loveth... Then maketh a lie.
entries.speaker: Vernon Ephesian

entries.text: [ agents shouting ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Mulder, no! You're dead!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What is he doing?
entries.speaker: BATF Agent

entries.text: [ sobs ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Behold, I am alive forevermore.
entries.speaker: Vernon Ephesian

entries.text: At times, I almost dream. I, too, have spent a life the sages' way... And tread once more familiar paths. Perchance, I've perished in an arrogant self-reliance an age ago, and, in that act, a prayer for one more chance went up... So earnest, so-- instinct with better light let in by death... That life was blotted out not so completely... But scattered wrecks, enough of it to remain dim memories... As now... When seems once more... The goal in sight again.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
